stops.name: Parque natural de los Volcanes
stops.detail: The Volcanoes Natural Park is a Spanish Natural Park situated on the Canary Island of Lanzarote. It has an area of 10158 hectares that belong to the municipalities of Tinakho, Athias and Yaiza. It was declared a park on June 19, 1987.
